Sample: osv_ossfuzz_OSV-2025-363
Project: jq
Public id: OSV-2025-363

Issue description:
A heap buffer overflow occurs when formatting an empty string because the data returned by `jv_string_empty` is not properly null-terminated. Operations that treat this string data as a null-terminated string may read or write past the end of the heap buffer.
